request: 修复 build.command 下载 Codex Bridge 宿主源码连接拒绝；缓存校验源码包并隔离宿主组件构建阶段
acceptance: Normal macOS source build can use a verified host-prepared source archive when container egress is unavailable
Downloaded, cached and explicitly supplied archives always match the pinned SHA-256; transient retries are bounded
UI edits do not invalidate the independent host-component stage
Actual Docker build completes with source/component identity checked; production is not restarted
Existing launcher ownership, image verification and failure preservation behavior remains intact
scope: scripts/build-codex-host.py source preparation and verified caching
Dockerfile and Dockerfile.local independent component stage
Scoped cache ignore rules, focused tests and build documentation

requirements.summary: Confirmed build.command fails at GitHub codeload in the Docker host-component step. Host download succeeds. Preserve pinned integrity, existing data/configuration and production lifecycle.

design.summary: Host prepares and verifies the content-addressed source archive for Docker; direct Docker retains verified-cache/bounded-download fallback. Both Dockerfiles compile unchanged host inputs in an independent stage. Startup/configuration stays behind existing image verification.

implementation.summary: Implemented verified host staging/cache, bounded fallback download and independent Docker host stages; existing launcher startup/image guards retained.

verification.summary: 8 focused source/cache tests, 25 launcher contract tests and the final quick profile passed. Actual Docker component build with RUN networking disabled compiled all six binaries; checksums and VERSION 0.4.0 passed. Changing an application file reused the host stage as CACHED. Full canonical launcher build-only completed, go vet and runtime compilation passed, source/image labels verified. Isolated candidate healthz passed with writable temporary data/workspace and a 768 MiB cap. Dockerfile.local was structurally tested; its complete build was not run.

documentation.summary: Documented staged archive/cache lifecycle, native Windows fallback and first-build network limits.

cleanup.summary: Temporary probe restored its file byte-for-byte; isolated smoke containers removed. Generated source archive stays ignored and available for future builds. Production container identity/image and .env checksum unchanged; original service had already exited before this validation.

release.summary: No remote push, public release or production restart. Candidate build validation only.

rollback: Revert source commits before deployment. Existing service/image/configuration retained throughout build validation.
handoff: Local main includes fix 92e95b842981cce06c8641d39a6330eabbd1d520. Verified candidate image aide:source-cache-743-92e95b8 retained. No push, release or production startup performed. Normal build.command is ready for the user to rerun.
